optimized_sql:
SELECT w_state, i_item_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number
      AND cr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS cr ON true
JOIN warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01') AS date_dim_filtered ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
WHERE item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
